_comment: Canonical region registry shared by ALL modules (program seeds, model, oracle, agent). region_id is a u16 used as an on-chain PDA seed. Risk values are scaled to BASIS POINTS (0-10000) on-chain; off-chain the model emits a probability in [0,1]. threshold_bps is the ON-CHAIN source of truth committed via initialize_region and is immutable thereafter (see RISK_SCALE).

regions.name: Sarno, Campania (IT)
regions.description: Sarno-Quindici area, Campania, Italy. Reference site for the catastrophic May 1998 debris flows. Used for the historical rainfall replay demo.

regions.name: Quindici, Campania (IT)
regions.description: Quindici municipality, Campania, Italy. Pyroclastic-soil slopes, high landslide susceptibility.
